title: Design System: Learn Anything — The Answer Sheet

print-ink.note: Maps to --primary. Action ink: buttons, filled bubbles, wordmark, caret, selection. Night-desk rendition inverts this role to paper ink #e7ebde on ground #191c15.

paper-white.note: Maps to --surface-container-lowest / --on-primary. The sheet itself: cards, option boxes, chips. Night desk: #121510.

exam-paper.note: Maps to --background. Warm card-stock page ground, never pure white. Night desk: #191c15.

sheet-stock.note: Maps to --surface-container-low. Recessed form furniture: rail strip, control chips. Night desk: #1e2218.

pencil.note: Maps to --secondary. Meta/pending graphite voice. Night desk: #aab69c.

pencil-meta.note: Maps to --on-surface-variant. Meta copy, timestamps, unreached labels. Night desk: #aab0a0.

stamp-green.note: Maps to --tertiary. Reserved for verified/passed only. Night desk: #85b896.

stamp-green-field.note: Maps to --tertiary-container. Background behind verified/correct marks. Night desk: #2d4734.

red-pen.note: Maps to --error. Reserved for misses, corrections, reveals, and the red sheet number only. Night desk: #e0765c.

red-pen-field.note: Maps to --error-container. Background behind struck/missed answers. Night desk: #4d2118.

rule.note: Maps to --outline-variant. Borders, ruled-paper lines, double rules, dashed ahead-connectors. Night desk: #3c4133.

rule-strong.note: Maps to --outline. Stronger printed rules, quote borders, neutral verdict top rule. Night desk: #8f9683.

highlighter.note: The --marker pigment. Applied only as a translucent wash (color-mix 52% light / 36% dark) on the learner's own narrowed goal in the intake transcript. Bounded exception; nothing else may use it.

display.purpose: The record header band title and dialog masthead: Archivo 700 uppercase, widened tracking, closed by a double rule.

title.purpose: Sheet card goal titles, quiz prompts, session workspace header line.

body.purpose: All teaching copy and option text; plain Source Sans 3 at 15px+, legible at any age, never uppercase.

label.purpose: Monospace uppercase caps: stamps, rail step names, REVEAL, AGAIN/HARD/GOOD/EASY, verdict lines. The build's extension of the mono vocabulary to FORM labels.

code.purpose: Monospace data: red sheet numbers, zero-padded counters, timestamps, batch positions.

shadows.name: sheet (night desk)
shadows.value: 0 1px 0 color-mix(in oklab, #3c4133 80%, transparent), 0 2px 5px -2px color-mix(in oklab, #000 45%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: --shadow-sheet at rest: the sheet's edge contact on the desk.

shadows.name: sheet (exam paper)
shadows.value: 0 1px 0 color-mix(in oklab, #c9c5b4 90%, transparent), 0 2px 5px -2px color-mix(in oklab, #1f231a 22%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: --shadow-sheet on paper: 1px edge line plus a tight ink-tinted drop.

shadows.name: sheet-raised (night desk)
shadows.value: 0 2px 0 color-mix(in oklab, #3c4133 90%, transparent), 0 8px 18px -6px color-mix(in oklab, #000 55%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: --shadow-sheet-raised hover/attention state, paired with a -1px translate. The only second level.

shadows.name: stamp inner rule
shadows.purpose: The inner border of a real stamp's double outline, tinted from the stamp's own ink; 2px inset on the 96px completion stamp.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: The single easing shared by every authored moment; exponential ease-out from an already-visible default.

motion.name: bubble-fill
motion.purpose: A progress bubble inks in (scale 0.5→1, opacity 0.4→1). Quiz answers and rail steps.

motion.name: stamp-press
motion.purpose: A stamp settles from scale 1.08 / rotate -4° / 1px blur to rest at rotate -2°.

motion.name: sheet-settle
motion.purpose: A sheet card lands on the desk (6px rise); list cards stagger 40ms apart, capped at 320ms.

motion.name: pen-draw
motion.purpose: The red-pen cross: two hand-drawn pathLength strokes, never an icon dash trick.

motion.name: dot-breathe
motion.purpose: The breathing ink dot inside a current bubble.

motion.name: reduced-motion guard
motion.purpose: Every authored animation is switched off; the flow never depends on motion to be understood.

components.name: Ink Block Button
components.description: The page's single heavy primary CTA — a solid print-ink block resting at sheet contact, lifting one step on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ink"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>Start New Session</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--primary, #1f231a); color: var(--primary-foreground, #fcfaf1); padding: 12px 20px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sheet, 0 1px 0 #c9c5b4, 0 2px 5px -2px rgba(31,35,26,0.22)); transition: all 150ms; } .ds-btn-ink:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sheet-raised, 0 2px 0 #c9c5b4, 0 8px 18px -6px rgba(31,35,26,0.3)); } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #1f231a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Reveal Control (outline stamp)
components.description: A hard 3px outline-stamp control with monospace caps; hover fills the block. Used for Reveal in the review deck footer.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-reveal"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M2 12s3.5-7 10-7 10 7 10 7-3.5 7-10 7-10-7-10-7Z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/></svg>Reveal</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-reveal { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--primary, #1f231a); border: 2px solid var(--primary, #1f231a); border-radius: 3px; padding: 8px 20px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; transition: all 150ms; } .ds-btn-reveal:hover { background: var(--primary, #1f231a); color: var(--primary-foreground, #fcfaf1); } .ds-btn-reveal:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #1f231a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Confidence Controls (AGAIN / HARD / GOOD / EASY)
components.description: The graded scale chips: a 3px top rule carries the rung (red pen → pencil → ink container → filled ink); hover adopts the rung color. Disabled while a recording is in flight.
components.css: .ds-confidence-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-confidence { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: var(--surface-container-lowest, #fcfaf1); color: var(--on-surface, #1f231a); border: 1px solid var(--outline-variant, #c9c5b4); border-radius: 3px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; transition: all 150ms; } .ds-confidence .ds-rule { position: absolute; inset: 0 0 auto 0; height: 3px; } .ds-is-again .ds-rule { background: var(--error, #b3382b); } .ds-is-hard .ds-rule { background: var(--secondary, #565141); } .ds-is-good .ds-rule { background: var(--primary-container, #2c3125); } .ds-is-easy .ds-rule { background: var(--primary, #1f231a); } .ds-is-again:hover { border-color: var(--error, #b3382b); color: var(--error, #b3382b); } .ds-is-hard:hover { border-color: var(--secondary, #565141); color: var(--on-surface, #1f231a); } .ds-is-good:hover { border-color: var(--primary, #1f231a); color: var(--primary, #1f231a); } .ds-is-easy:hover { background: var(--primary, #1f231a); color: var(--primary-foreground, #fcfaf1); } .ds-confidence:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #1f231a); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-confidence:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Quiz Option Box
components.description: A printed lettered option, shown at rest and in its revealed states (correct marked green, wrong pick struck with the red-pen cross).
components.css: .ds-options { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-option { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: var(--surface-container-lowest, #fcfaf1); color: var(--on-surface, #1f231a); border: 1px solid var(--outline-variant, #c9c5b4); border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 16px; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-option:hover { border-color: var(--primary, #1f231a); } .ds-option:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #1f231a); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-text { flex: 1; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; } .ds-letter { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border: 1px solid var(--outline-variant, #c9c5b4); border-radius: 3px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--on-surface-variant, #4b4839); } .ds-reveal-correct { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tertiary, #2e6b45) 60%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tertiary-container, #d5e4d9) 50%, transparent); color: var(--tertiary, #2e6b45); } .ds-letter-correct { border-color: var(--tertiary, #2e6b45); background: var(--tertiary, #2e6b45); color: var(--on-tertiary, #f7f4e9); } .ds-reveal-wrong { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--error, #b3382b) 60%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--error-container, #f1dcd5) 40%, transparent); color: var(--error, #b3382b); } .ds-letter-wrong { border-color: var(--error, #b3382b); background: var(--error, #b3382b); color: var(--on-error, #fcfaf1); }

components.name: Sheet Card (History / Review deck)
components.description: A filed answer sheet: punch-hole margin, ruled header strip with a red monospace sheet number, title below. Carries no stage vocabulary (product decision #46).
components.html:
No. 4F2A3 hours ago

How gears actually work
components.css: .ds-sheet-card { display: block; position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: var(--surface-container-lowest, #fcfaf1); color: var(--on-surface, #1f231a); border: 1px solid var(--outline-variant, #c9c5b4); border-radius: 6px; padding: 20px 20px 20px 32px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sheet, 0 1px 0 #c9c5b4, 0 2px 5px -2px rgba(31,35,26,0.22)); transition: all 150ms; text-decoration: none; } .ds-sheet-card:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sheet-raised, 0 2px 0 #c9c5b4, 0 8px 18px -6px rgba(31,35,26,0.3)); } .ds-sheet-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #1f231a); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-punches { position: absolute; left: 10px; top: 0; bottom: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 20px; } .ds-punches i { display: block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--outline-variant, #c9c5b4) 70%, transparent); background: var(--surface, #f0eee3); } .ds-sheet-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--outline-variant, #c9c5b4) 60%, transparent); padding-bottom: 8px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; } .ds-sheet-no { font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: var(--error, #b3382b); } .ds-sheet-time { color: var(--on-surface-variant, #4b4839); } .ds-sheet-title { margin-top: 12px; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Phase Stamp
components.description: The phase vocabulary: a rotated, double-outlined monospace-caps stamp. Shown working (pencil dashed), executing (filled ink), and verified (green).
components.html: Probing Drilling Complete
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; transform: rotate(-2deg); border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 3px; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, currentColor 35%, transparent); } .ds-stamp-working { color: var(--on-surface-variant, #4b4839); border-style: dashed; } .ds-stamp-executing { color: var(--primary-foreground, #fcfaf1); background: var(--primary, #1f231a); border-color: var(--primary, #1f231a); } .ds-stamp-complete { color: var(--tertiary, #2e6b45); }

components.name: Progress Rail & Bubbles
components.description: The sole progress device: a printed row of bubbles and mono-caps step labels; done steps join with a solid ink rule, ahead steps with a dashed rule.
components.html: ClarifyingProbingPlanning
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px; width: 100%; background: var(--surface-container-low, #f7f4e9); padding: 12px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--outline-variant, #c9c5b4); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 -2px var(--outline-variant, #c9c5b4); } .ds-step { display: flex; flex: 1; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-bubble { position: relative; display: inline-flex; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1.5px solid var(--outline-variant, #c9c5b4); } .ds-bubble-filled { border-color: var(--primary, #1f231a); background: var(--primary, #1f231a); } .ds-bubble-current { border-color: var(--primary, #1f231a); } .ds-bubble-current i { position: absolute; inset: 0; margin: auto; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary, #1f231a); } .ds-step-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: var(--on-surface-variant, #4b4839); } .ds-step-label.ds-current { color: var(--primary, #1f231a); } .ds-link { flex: 1; margin: 0 8px; margin-top: 7px; height: 2px; background: var(--primary, #1f231a); } .ds-link:not(.ds-link-walked) { height: 0; border-top: 1px dashed var(--outline-variant, #c9c5b4); background: none; }

components.name: Counter Chip (form page number)
components.description: Zero-padded monospace slide/progress counter, typeset like a printed form page number.
components.css: .ds-counter { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: var(--surface-container-lowest, #fcfaf1); border: 1px solid var(--outline-variant, #c9c5b4); border-radius: 3px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; color: var(--on-surface-variant, #4b4839); } .ds-counter b { font-weight: 700; color: var(--primary, #1f231a); }

narrative.overview:
Study is a sheet you fill in. Every surface is printed paper: a record header closed by a double rule, sessions as paper cards punched for a binder, questions as lettered option boxes, progress as a row of filled bubbles, phase as a rotated rubber stamp pressed onto the page. The system refuses the chat-hero arrangement and the progress-bar LMS dashboard outright; it holds instead to a two-ink press — print ink for action, red pen for correction, stamp green for verified, pencil for meta — on a paper ground with a faint grain (3.5% opacity) that says "sheet", not "panel".

The world ships in two complete renditions: exam paper (light, warm card stock with near-white sheets) and the night desk (dark, the exact same press inverted). No role changes meaning between them.

Type carries the same printed-form logic: Archivo sets record headers like a printed masthead; Source Sans 3 is the plain body voice legible at any age; JetBrains Mono is the form's own hand — codes, counters, and the caps pressed into stamps and controls.
keyCharacteristics: Two-ink discipline: ink for action, red pen only for misses/corrections/reveals, stamp green only for verified/passed, pencil for meta/pending/rules.
Bubbles are the sole progress device — empty, filled, or current. No progress bars.
Stamps (slightly rotated, double-ruled, monospace caps) are the phase vocabulary; session cards carry no stage vocabulary at all (product decision #46).
Square-cut form geometry: form surfaces at or below 6px radius; full circles reserved for bubbles and punch holes.
Ruled-paper panels, double-rule dividers, and a ruled meta strip with a red monospace "No." on every sheet card.
No glow, no gradients, no glass. Depth is the contact shadow of paper on a desk.

rules.name: The Two-Ink Press Rule
rules.body: Every color in the app is one of the press roles, and each role is reserved: ink acts, red pen corrects, stamp green verifies, pencil annotates. A color that crosses its reservation is a bug, not a variant.

rules.name: The Red Sheet Number Rule
rules.body: Every filed sheet prints its identity as a red monospace "No." on its ruled header strip. It is the card's fingerprint, not decoration.

rules.name: The Highlighter Exception
rules.body: --marker is the one wash outside the press, bounded to the learner's own narrowed goal in the intake transcript. A highlighter belongs on an answer sheet — but only on the learner's own answer.

rules.name: The Printed-Form Rule
rules.body: Headings are set like a printed form: Archivo, uppercase where it is a form header or masthead, with widened tracking. The teaching voice itself is never uppercase and never the display face.

rules.name: The Mono-Vocabulary Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is the form's hand: codes and counters per the brief, extended by the build to FORM labels — the caps on stamps and the REVEAL / AGAIN / HARD / GOOD / EASY controls. Mono never sets body copy or teaching prose.

rules.name: The Sheet-Contact Rule
rules.body: Every lifted thing shows its edge. A shadow is always a contact line plus a tight drop; anything diffuse, wide, or colored is outside this world.

rules.name: The One Ink Block Rule
rules.body: Each page carries exactly one heavy solid-ink primary CTA; everything else is an outline, a chip, or a plain link.

rules.name: The Bubble-Only Progress Rule
rules.body: Progress is a row of bubbles in three states only — empty, filled, current. There are no bars, rings, or percentage meters.

dos: Do keep every color inside its press role: ink acts, red pen only corrects, stamp green only verifies, pencil only annotates.
Do mark progress with bubbles only — empty, filled, or current — and connect walked steps with solid ink rules, ahead steps with dashed ones.
Do set phase as a stamp: rotated -2 degrees, double-outlined, monospace caps, pressed in.
Do file every sheet the same way: punch-hole margin, ruled header strip, red monospace "No.", 6px corners, sheet-contact shadow.
Do give each page exactly one ink block — the heavy solid-ink primary CTA.
Do use the highlighter wash (--marker) on the learner's own narrowed goal in intake, and there only.
Do keep type legible at any age in both scripts: Source Sans 3 body at 15px+, uppercase Archivo only for form headers, mono only for codes/counters/form labels.
Do ship every surface in both renditions — exam paper and night desk — from the same role tokens.
donts: Don't use red pen on anything that succeeded, or stamp green on anything unverified.
Don't put stage or phase vocabulary on session cards (product decision #46).
Don't round form surfaces past 8px; full circles are reserved for bubbles and punch holes.
Don't use glow, gradients, glass, or diffuse ambient shadows — depth is contact plus a tight drop.
Don't use progress bars, rings, or percentage meters; the bubble row is the progress device.
Don't treat LLM-authored slide content in the sandbox iframe as app chrome; the system frames it, never styles it from outside.
Don't invent a second highlighter, a second accent, or a decorative color; the press has its quota.
